title: Rent Is Due
description: Baba Landlord needs his compound rent paid. Accumulate 25,000 Naira to secure your room.

steps.text: Raise at least 25,000 Naira in your cash reserves.

title: Stock Your Stall
description: Demonstrate retail readiness by keeping at least 3 trade items in your inventory.

steps.text: Hold at least 3 items in your inventory.

title: Rush Hour Run
description: Prove your route stamina across the expressway corridor by reaching Level 2.

steps.text: Reach class Level 2 through hard road hustle.

title: Earning Street Respect
description: In Oshodi, your name is your capital. Build your community Respect to 20.

steps.text: Achieve a Respect score of at least 20.

title: Clear Your Standing
description: Maintain a calm, lawful presence on the streets by keeping Heat down to 0.

steps.text: Maintain total compliance with zero Heat.

title: Light Up the Junction
description: Power cuts threaten evening commerce. Keep emergency cash ready to fund power supplies.

steps.text: Hold at least 15,000 Naira to fund emergency power supplies.

title: Union Recognition
description: Win the full respect of the bus park leaders by reaching Level 3.

steps.text: Reach Level 3 to gain senior recognition in the park.

title: Community Trust
description: Build high goodwill with local financial agents by holding 30,000 Naira in working funds.

steps.text: Hold 30,000 Naira cash balance demonstrating liquidity and prudence.

title: Master Your Craft
description: Achieve class Level 5 and unlock your chosen subclass specialization.

steps.text: Advance to Level 5 and select your subclass.

title: Heart of Oshodi
description: The ultimate neighbourhood milestone: reach 35 Respect across the district.

steps.text: Reach at least 35 Respect across the district.
